text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — SDK PR is changing the client init signature and it blocks the console patch. We need to coordinate merge order and reviewers.
Jun: Which PRs are we talking about? Can you drop links + the breaking bit? :eyes:
Aisha: sure — SDK: https://git.redwood.ai/sdk/pull/582 (branch: feat/new-init). API shim: https://git.redwood.ai/api/pull/420 (branch: api/add-client-shim). Console: https://git.redwood.ai/console/pull/331 (branch: console/sdk-init-update).
Aisha: Breaking change is `Client(config)` -> `Client({ apiKey, region, opts })`. Small but everywhere. Example: `const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us-west-2' })`
Tom: Ok. Helm/runtime also needs an image-tag bump for the runtime sidecar that the console deploy expects. I opened helm PR: https://git.redwood.ai/charts/pull/127 (helm/runtime-image-bump). That one assumes console will use the new client, so ordering matters.
Priya: So proposed merge order? API shim is tiny and non-breaking, SDK depends on API, console depends on SDK, helm depends on console/runtime image. I think: api -> sdk -> console -> helm -> runtime.
Jun: That seems right. Who needs to review SDK? @Tom and @Sam are listed as CODEOWNERS for sdk/client. @Sam can you take SDK review today?
Sam: I can review SDK later today, aiming to approve by 18:00 UTC. If I need changes I'll post inline.
Aisha: Thanks. CI note: SDK tests are flaky on windows but pass on linux; added a patch to the CI job.
ci-bot: SDK CI passed (linux), runs/582 — 1753128005 :white_check_mark:
Jun: Console PR: I can add the quick migration helper to avoid runtime break for older infra (small wrapper that maps old args to new shape). Would that let us decouple helm timing?
Priya: That would help, but we should still bump the runtime image ASAP. Recommend we schedule merges into tomorrow's 14:00 UTC deploy window so infra can validate. :calendar: 
Tom: +1 for 14:00 UTC. I'll hold my helm merge until console is green. I'll also tag eng-runtime on the helm PR for the image push.
Sam: SDK review done, left one nit about docstrings. Approving after nit fixed.
Aisha: I'll update console PR with the migration helper now and mark it draft->ready once tests pass.
ci-bot: Console CI started, runs/331 — 1753128120
Jun: If all goes well: plan = merge API (immediate) -> merge SDK (after Sam approves) -> deploy SDK package (internal registry) -> merge Console -> Helm -> Runtime. I'll post a short checklist in the PRs.
Priya: I'll be on-call during the 14:00 window to watch infra logs and rollback if anything weird. @Tom please ping me when helm is merged.
Tom: Will do. Also leaving a note: if SDK rollout shows client telemetry spike, we should mute alerts for 10m to avoid noise.
Aisha: Great coordination, thanks everyone. I'll ping this thread when each PR is merged. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks — feel free to @me if console migration helper touches SDK types.
ci-bot: API CI passed, runs/420 — 1753128250 :white_check_mark:
Aisha: API merged at 1753128275.
Jun: SDK merge pending Sam nitfix. ETA 30–60m.
Sam: Nit fixed, SDK approved and merged at 1753128290. :rocket:
Aisha: Console draft updated with migration helper and tests green. Marking ready for review.
Tom: Helm will wait for console merge, targeting 14:00 UTC window as discussed.
Priya: Copy that. I'll standby.
Aisha: Thread update: all merges sequenced, deployment scheduled for 1753140000 (14:00 UTC tomorrow). I'll send a final reminder 30m before.
Jun: Awesome — thanks for moving fast.
